A.note: Readable scene with a rock, sea and ships. The ground is a smooth green-yellow colour field. The camps are flat tan rectangles with tiny box tents. The trees are sparse black dots.

B.note: Top-down view with no rock, sea or context. Rows of identical white boxes sit on flat tan slabs, like a board game. The only interesting element is the trench line, which is hard to read.

C.note: Same composition as A. The ground has better texture and the vegetation is denser, darker and more natural. The sea is brighter and has cloud reflections. The camps are still flat tan rectangles with tiny boxes.

why: C and A share the same readable composition of rock, sea, ships and camps, and C has better terrain texture and vegetation. B loses all context and reads as a board-game grid.
top_fix_for_best: Replace the flat tan camp rectangles and uniform box tents with irregular, textured camp ground. Use varied canvas tents, paths, smoke, figures and trenches or earthworks, and add atmospheric haze and long shadows to give depth.
